CloudDocument.title: CloudDocument
CloudDocument.description: Metadata and sync tracking record for a user's PDF or office document synced to Google Cloud.

userId.description: Owner Firebase Auth UID matching request.auth.uid.

sizeBytes.description: Document byte size on device and cloud.

storagePath.description: Firebase Storage object path under users/{userId}/pdfs/.

syncState.description: Cloud upload status of the document.

folderName.description: Optional originating folder label on device.

createdAt.description: Server creation timestamp written via FieldValue.serverTimestamp().

updatedAt.description: Server last update timestamp written via FieldValue.serverTimestamp().

AppReleaseConfig.title: AppReleaseConfig
AppReleaseConfig.description: Public read-only release manifest used by non-Play-Store APK builds to check for newer updates.

latestVersionCode.description: Monotonically increasing Android versionCode of the latest APK release.

latestVersionName.description: Human-readable version label such as 1.1 or 2.0.

apkUrl.description: HTTPS direct download URL for the signed APK package.

releaseNotes.description: Short summary of improvements included in this release.

forceUpdate.description: Whether the update dialog should require installing before continuing.

/users/{userId}/cloud_documents/{docId}.description: Per-user cloud-synced PDF and document records.

/app_config/{configId}.description: Read-only app configuration documents such as latest_release for direct APK update checks.
